title: Sultane Arab Wal
body:
ya zaamin e aahu ya sayyedi ya hashmi
jaan o dil e zehra o ali
sadiq ameen baabul yaqeen
behre mubeen tanveer e jali
kulle wafa kulle shifa
kulle ata la raib wali
<<DIVIDER>>
sultan e arab wal ajam maula riza
ay waaris e hussain ya sartaj e ambiya
<<DIVIDER>>
mushkil kusha ke laal tu mushkil kushaai kar
daste dua buland hai haajat rawayi kar
bhatke huwe hai raah se tu rehnumayi kar
ya shaahe khurasan ho nazre karam zara
sultan e arab...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay waaris e sakhawat e ajdaad al madad
tang dast muflison ki hai faryad al madad
hum ho ghamon ki qaid se azad al madad
ahle aza ke waali o waaris ay badshaah
sultan e arab...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay saahibe kamaal o karamaat zee hasham
darbar mein tumhare pareshan kyun ho hum
ahle aza ka rakh le ba-haqqe aza bharam
hai waasta imame hussain e ghareeb ka
sultan e arab...
<<DIVIDER>>
muflis ko be-zaron ko ata kar de bu-zari
makrooz ka tu karz ada kar de ay saqi
imdad ke hai tujhse talabgaar matami
apni nigah e khair mein rakhna hame sada
sultan e arab...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay shaahe wafa ya maula riza
ay daste ataa ya maula riza
har gham ki dawa ya maula riza
damaan e baqa ya maula riza
sun lije dua ya maula riza
har dil ki sada ya maula riza
sarkar hum ne aap ko zaamin bana diya
sultan e arab...
<<DIVIDER>>
aulaad ki talab hai jinhe unpe kar nazar
mayoos bibiyon ki duaon ko de asar
taqdeer ko badal ke tu kar de ataa pisar
ay badshaah dar pe hai tere ye ilteja
sultan e arab...
<<DIVIDER>>
toote hai jo masayib o aalaam aap par
kaise karun bayan ke phatne ko hai jigar
kehti hai fatema bhi yehi sar ko peet kar
padti hai tere gham mein khudayi bhi marsiya
sultan e arab...
<<DIVIDER>>
mamoon ko jo bughz tha usne dikha diya
jis ghar mein aap thay wahan pehra laga diya
angoor mein hi zehr mila kar khila diya
maara layeen ne aap ko be-jurm o be-khata
sultan e arab...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye haye mere aseer ghareebul watan imam
ro ro ke keh rahe thay ye mashad mein khaas o aam
taboot ko utha ke ye karne lage kalaam
kehte hai khaak uda ke taqi wa musibata
sultan e arab...
<<DIVIDER>>
ya sayyedi ye khaas ataa mujhpe ho sada
shayar bhi naujakhwan bhi hoon zehra ke laal ka
safdar ko tu ne ek hunar aur de diya
ay behre inayaat o karamaat shukriya
sultan e arab...
author: Safdar Abbas
